summary.headline: Jupiter Combustion in the Fiery Triplicity
summary.text: Astrological effects of Jupiter’s presence, adverse aspects, and combustion in the fiery triplicity, including predictions for kings, judges, nobles, weather, trade, floods, disease, travel, and regional calamities. The book Safinah is cited for Jupiter’s combustion, whose effects may last up to a year.
